A dense evidence page that takes eight seconds to load will not be used at a podium; the build FAILS on regression. P21.6 adds a separate /curate/** block: the authenticated curation pages are under WCAG 2.2 AA (a11y 100) but NOT the public zero-JS/performance budget (perf advisory; script size not asserted — a JS island for keyboard shortcuts/diff views is permitted there).

collect.//url: A representative page per budget block (lhci autodiscovery otherwise caps at 5 arbitrary pages and never reaches the islands): public zero-JS content pages, a /curate/** island-allowance page (ADR-068), and the three public interactive islands /map//network//search/ (ADR-097), so every block below is actually exercised.

assertMatrix.//: Public content pages: the full zero-JS + performance budget. Excludes /curate/** (ADR-068) and the three opt-in islands /map//network//search/ (ADR-097) — every other public page ships script size 0.
Curation pages (/curate/**): WCAG 2.2 AA enforced; performance advisory only; script size NOT asserted (island allowance, ADR-068). Not the public budget.

The three public interactive islands (/map/, /network/, /search/): the opt-in-island budget (P27.9, ADR-097 extending ADR-068). WCAG 2.2 AA is enforced (a11y 100); performance is advisory. Each island preserves a no-JS fallback (SIG-UI-050); every OTHER public page keeps script size 0 under the block above. P32.15 (SIG-FIND-005, ADR-134): explicit per-island script/total ceilings below — measured baselines + headroom recorded in web/tests/e2e/island-budgets.json + docs/build/reports/p32.15-island-budgets.md; asserted again (wire-measured, incl. the map worker) by tests/e2e/budget.spec.ts.
/map/ per-island budget (P32.15): MapLibre+PMTiles island ≈ 1.79 MB raw script-family (incl. the 507 KB worker) at the P32.15 baseline; ceiling 2.0 MB script / 2.3 MB total.
/network/ per-island budget (P32.15): React+island ≈ 230 KB raw at baseline; ceiling 400 KB script / 450 KB total.
/search/ per-island budget (P32.15): React+island ≈ 228 KB raw at baseline; ceiling 400 KB script / 450 KB total.
